data.description:
## Context / Problem
`structured.parse_structured` and `structured.check_response` preserve deterministic repair, schema and sentinel extraction, and provider stop/refusal safety (`src/rebar/llm/structured.py:361-443,630-677`). `_pai_structured` currently wraps those rules in its own attempt loop (`src/rebar/llm/structured_run.py:87-178`). RP-01 needs the policy expressed through Pydantic output processing before retry scheduling can move safely.

## Approach
Add a focused Pydantic output-policy adapter in new `src/rebar/llm/pai_output.py`. It calls the existing stop/refusal guard before deterministic parse and validation, returns the typed output on success, and raises the exact Rebar-owned `StructuredOutputError` through Pydantic `ModelRetry` on retryable validation failure. Terminal refusal/content-filter errors propagate without becoming retry prompts. Keep `structured.py` as the pure parser and safety authority; this story does not change scheduling, fallback, usage, or serialized result shapes. This narrow adapter lets the next story use documented Pydantic validation without cloning repair policy.

## Scope
- `src/rebar/llm/pai_output.py` — new Pydantic output adapter and exact Rebar-error carrier.
- `src/rebar/llm/structured.py` — expose only the smallest existing pure entry point needed by the adapter; preserve parser behavior.
- `tests/unit/test_pai_output.py` — new real-Pydantic `FunctionModel` contract tests.
- `tests/unit/test_structured.py` — retain the historical deterministic repair and extraction oracle.

## Testing
- Happy path: native and prompted valid responses produce the typed object through a real Pydantic Agent output path.
- Recovery path: repairable JSON, sentinel content, and decoy-plus-valid-object cases retain current deterministic selection.
- Failure path: invalid output carries the same Rebar error object into the Pydantic cause chain; refusal/content-filter is terminal and creates no retry prompt.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A real Pydantic `Agent` using the adapter returns the expected typed object for valid native and prompted fixtures; verified by `tests/unit/test_pai_output.py` native and prompted cases.
- [ ] The historical repair, sentinel, and decoy corpus produces the same values before and after the adapter; verified by the focused `test_pai_output.py` matrix plus `tests/unit/test_structured.py`.
- [ ] A retryable validation failure preserves the exact Rebar `StructuredOutputError` object in the Pydantic cause chain; verified by an identity assertion in `test_pai_output.py`.
- [ ] Refusal and content-filter responses raise the existing terminal Rebar subtype without emitting a Pydantic retry prompt; verified by one-call failure cases.
- [ ] No retry loop, provider selection, usage projection, or persistence code is added to `pai_output.py`; verified by direct review and the module-size and complexity gates.
data.title: RP-01 S1 — Adapt Rebar output policy to Pydantic validation
